```yaml
name: E2E UI Tests (Playwright) on Kind

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'playwright/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'requirements.txt'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-kind-pr.yaml'

concurrency:
  group: e2e-kind-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  e2e-kind:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          activate-environment: 'kagenti'
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install

      - name: Create Kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@v1.14.0
        with:
          config: .github/kind-config.yaml
          cluster_name: kagenti-e2e
          wait: 60

      - name: Deploy backend and Keycloak
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f k8s/backend.yaml
          kubectl apply -f k8s/keycloak.yaml
          kubectl rollout status deployment/backend --timeout=120s
          kubectl rollout status deployment/keycloak --timeout=120s

      - name: Port-forward services
        run: |
          kubectl port-forward svc/backend 8080:80 &
          kubectl port-forward svc/keycloak 8081:80 &
          echo "Waiting for services to be reachable..."
          until curl -s http://localhost:8080/health; do sleep 1; done
          until curl -s http://localhost:8081/health; do sleep 1; done
        shell: bash

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        env:
          BASE_URL: http://localhost:8080
          KEYCLOAK_URL: http://localhost:8081
        run: npx playwright test --reporter=junit

      - name: Upload Playwright test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-results
          path: test-results

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Playwright UI Tests
          path: test-results/*.xml
          reporter: junit
          fail-on-error: true
```
